title: Answer: if treating cells as goal-seekers gave no gain in control

statements.text: The framework is judged by its yield. If treating cell collectives as goal-directed agents, and rewriting their setpoints, gave no better prediction and control than micromanaging molecules, the framework would fail.

sources.locator: section Philosophical Foundations of an Approach to Diverse Intelligences
sources.quote: The goal is to produce a framework that drives experimental research programs, not only philosophical debate
Future empirical work will reveal whether Scale Free Cognition is a useful way to organize what we know
